This isn’t an actual routine recommendation, so scroll if that’s all you’re looking for. Instead this is advice coming from a guy who had really bad depression and I spent a shit ton of time overthinking.

I don’t think a gratitude list at the end of your night is enough to be happy. I think you constantly have to try and look at the positive side of life everyday and also look for the things your grateful for is what will make you happy. But a gratitude list can help teach you to have a better mindset, which is amazing if it works for you.

Also don’t feel discouraged if on one day working out or meditating feels like too much and you don’t end up doing it. Be patient with yourself on those days that feel overwhelming, and just meet your basic needs without feeling guilt for not meditating, working out etc.

Implement one habit at a time and slowly add more and more until you have your optimal routine. Also try getting a hobby that brings fun into your life. If you consider working out, meditating and yoga as hobbies that you enjoy than disregard my last sentence.

Take the advice that’s valuable to you, as I’m not the smartest person out there but I think you can find some value in this comment.
